associations.rationale: This defines the auxiliary Heisenberg-group presentation used by the semidirect-product argument but gives no representation classification.
The equivalence supplies the transport from the auxiliary presentation to the usual Heisenberg group rather than stating the classification.
This classifies representations of the auxiliary HeisenbergGroup presentation and is the semidirect-product intermediate for the requested result.
The type directly gives the exhaustive classification for the usual finite Heisenberg group, including the possible dimensions and their counts.
This directly states a strengthened classification for the usual Heisenberg group, adding explicit named models to the counts and dimensions.
